QUOTE: "`run_async_ask` is a detached thread that captures `this` and `handle_`. Its safety depends on the bridge and handle outliving the worker. The index doesn't show that shutdown waits for in-flight async asks"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer identifies the async-ask worker as a detached thread (the only one listed as detached) and notes nothing joins it at shutdown, so it can outlive its scope.
